I hear you, Ashley. Some days the energy just isn't there, and forcing a heavy session when you're feeling like this usually backfires. 

We have a couple of good options here. We can make today's session a lot lighter so you can just go through the motions and keep the momentum going, or we can simply push today's lower body workout to tomorrow and make today a rest day. 

How does that sound to you—would you rather try a scaled-back, easier version today, or just take the day off and lift tomorrow?

turns.reply:
I'm really sorry to hear that, Ashley. When life gets heavy like that for weeks at a time, trying to keep up with a demanding training plan can start to feel like another chore instead of a release. 

If the current volume has been feeling like too much to carry lately, we can make an ongoing adjustment to your plan and make your sessions permanently lighter from here on out. That would take some of the pressure off while still keeping you moving. 

How does that sound to you—would you like to make the plan lighter overall, or do you just need a complete break from the gym for a little while?
